profileLabel: Strongly socially conservative; center-left economics; restrictive-leaning civil liberties; institution-supporting
summary: Manila 6th District representative with an unusually consistent social-conservative record: opposed divorce and SOGIE legislation and filed a bill to repeal the reproductive health law. Economic bills favor labor benefits and social pensions with mixed tax measures. Also authored anti-torture and transparency bills alongside a death-penalty restoration bill.
caveat: Scores rest on authored bills and press reports; plenary and committee votes were not reviewed. Social-values score reflects documented conduct; other three are bill-based.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Bills mandate 14th-month pay, raise healthcare-worker pay and social pensions (labor and social insurance lean left). Tax bills are mixed: sin-tax increases alongside church, senior and excise relief. Evidence is authored bills only; no votes reviewed.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04441, HB03060, HB05866, HB08479, HB10712, HB03063 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Strongly conservative
social.rationale: Led floor opposition to the 2024 absolute divorce bill and filed annulment-expansion instead (HB09105); filed RPRH Act repeal (HB05441); long-time SOGIE opponent, filed 'rights of heterosexuals' bill; Bible-in-curriculum bill. Consistent across four issues. No counterevidence found.

sources.text: Inquirer, divorce bill 'not a done deal' (c. 2024-05)
House member page, authored bills: HB05441, HB03043, HB05815, HB03071 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Mixed pattern: filed death-penalty restoration (HB03044) and co-authored espionage expansion (HB09642), but also principal author of extrajudicial-killing penalties (HB01629) and a national anti-torture preventive mechanism (HB03047). Bills only; no votes or statements reviewed.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB03044, HB01629, HB03047, HB09642 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Principal author of FOI implementation (HB03643) and budget-transparency system (HB06909); co-author of anti-dynasty bills; filed ConCon rather than assembly route (neutral). No oversight or judicial-independence conduct reviewed, so evidence is bill-based.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB03643, HB06909, HB08389, HB06771, HB03068 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
